name: aragon-photo-upload
description: Selfie upload with server-side validation (format, size, resolution, duplicates, blur, face checks).

scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:deploy -w @aragon/api && npm run models:fetch -w @aragon/api
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @aragon/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @aragon/api" "npm run dev -w @aragon/web"
